title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.26863v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are

translated_title: 无需语言预训练的文本到图像生成建模
translated_abstract: 现代文本到图像（T2I）系统使用互联网规模的文本语言预训练来实现文本条件下的图像生成。我们探究语言预训练对于强大的T2I生成是否必要。我们提出了Halcyon，这是一系列早期融合的多模态自回归模型，完全从零开始在GPIC（一个包含1亿图像-文本对的数据集）上预训练。Halcyon-0.52B以少18.2倍的预训练计算量超越了LlamaGen-XL/8（48.0 对比 63.3 gFD）。此外，Halcyon-1.6B以少275倍的预训练计算量超越了JiT-T2I-XXL/8++（35.3 对比 41.0 gFD）。对照实验表明，仅文本的预训练并不能改善T2I生成。Halcyon还通过用图像到文本（I2T）监督替代caption dropout来学习图像描述生成，并在相同的预训练预算下保持了有竞争力的T2I生成质量。我们证明了强大的T2I系统可以在没有互联网规模语言预训练的情况下从零开始训练。代码和模型已开源。
tldr: 本文提出完全从零预训练的早期融合多模态自回归模型家族Halcyon，证明无需互联网规模的语言预训练也能以大幅更少的计算量训练出强大且高质量的文本到图像生成模型。
en_tdlr: Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining, achieves strong text-to-image generation with up to 275× less pretraining compute than existing models.
